name: Idle Hands
tagline: Your trucks are lying to you. We've got the receipts.
positioning: GPS, engine, and idle-time telematics built for owner-operators who don't have a fleet manager — because they ARE the fleet manager.

hero.h1: Every idling engine is quietly setting your money on fire.
hero.sub: Idle Hands plugs into your rig, watches the diesel burn, the routes wander, and the odometer creep — then tells you exactly where your margin went. No dispatcher required.

features.title: Idle time, itemized
features.description: See every minute an engine ran while going nowhere, priced out in dollars. Show it to the driver who swears he 'barely idled.'

features.title: Routes that make sense
features.description: Live GPS with playback so you can settle the 'traffic was insane' debate without a shouting match.

features.title: Engine faults, translated
features.description: We turn cryptic OBD codes into plain English before the check-engine light becomes a $4,000 tow.

features.title: Fuel receipts that add up
features.description: Match card swipes to actual tank levels and catch the gallons that mysteriously never made it into the truck.

features.title: IFTA without tears
features.description: Miles-per-state logged automatically. Your quarterly fuel tax report writes itself while you sleep.

features.title: Alerts you can mute
features.description: Speeding, hard braking, after-hours movement — flagged instantly, and we won't spam you at 3am unless you asked.

testimonials.quote: Turns out one of my drivers idled 31 hours in a week. Idle Hands did the math, I did the firing. Fuel bill dropped 18% the next month.
testimonials.name: Dale Prokop

testimonials.quote: IFTA used to eat a full weekend every quarter. Now I export a PDF and go fishing. That alone paid for the seats.
testimonials.name: Renata Colón

testimonials.quote: The engine-fault translations caught a failing turbo before it stranded a load in Amarillo. Saved the customer, saved the truck, saved my sanity.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

pricing.blurb: One driver, one login, zero excuses. For the truly independent operator.
For the shop with a handful of rigs and no patience for spreadsheets.
Twenty-plus trucks and a dispatcher who wants their own login.

homepage.footerBlurb: Idle Hands is telematics for people who drive the truck, sign the checks, and answer the phone. Usually all before noon.
